journey.title: Register a device and stop it waking you up
journey.purpose: The owner adds a device, proves it can receive, and bounds when it is allowed to interrupt them. Without the second half, the owner mutes the channel and every promise the scenario makes downstream becomes void.

steps.intent: Add a first device and understand what will be needed to reach it before committing.
Send a test notification to the new device and see it confirmed, so registration is proven rather than assumed.
Set quiet hours in the owner's own timezone and understand that only critical urgency overrides them.
Mute one channel without losing the notifications it would have carried, so muting is a routing change rather than a silent drop.
